reels.title: M20 DIVAR
reels.caption:
You don't have no time. You have 4 hours a night on your phone. 🧱

Day 1, same evening. One lays a brick. One opens his phone. Day 30, the wall falls. He starts again. A year later, one built something. The other scrolled 1,460 hours.

Same evenings. Different year.

Send this to someone who says they have no time.

#discipline #screentime #selfimprovement #motivation #habits

reels.title: M22 GELECEK SEN (chat POV)
reels.caption:
Your future self just texted you. 📱

"You're about to scroll for 3 hours again. I know. I remember tonight. 10 pages. 20 pushups. Phone in another room. It felt like nothing. It changed everything."

Tonight is the night you start.

Send this to someone who needs this text.

#selfimprovement #futureself #discipline #motivation #habits
